name: SpraayBatch
description: Batch ERC-20 payouts for AI agents — pay up to 200 recipients in one atomic transaction on Base with any token. Gasless via CDP Paymaster (agents holding only tokens, zero ETH, can pay), non-custodial auto-wallet, and per-agent budget caps. An OpenClaw plugin.

walletKey.title: Wallet Private Key
walletKey.description: Sensitive. EVM wallet private key (0x + 64 hex). OPTIONAL — if you leave this empty, SpraayBatch AUTO-GENERATES a brand-new private key on first run and stores it in plaintext at ~/.spraay/.session with 0600 (owner-read/write only) permissions; the directory is created 0700. That key controls real funds and is the ONLY copy — it is never uploaded, escrowed, or recoverable by anyone, so if the file is lost or the machine dies, any funds it holds are gone permanently. BACK IT UP as soon as it is created: run `spraay-batch export-key` and store the output in a password manager. Treat the key and any backup like cash: never commit it, paste it into a chat, or put it in a shared config.

network.description: Base network for payments. Defaults to base-sepolia until you opt into mainnet.

enabled.description: Whether to sponsor gas so agents holding only ERC-20 tokens (zero ETH) can transact (needs paymasterUrl).

capUsd.description: Optional upper bound on sponsored gas spend (per period). Local enforcement is a future hook; the authoritative cap is your CDP dashboard paymaster policy.

paymasterUrl.title: CDP Paymaster URL
paymasterUrl.description: Sensitive. CDP Paymaster & Bundler RPC URL (https://api.developer.coinbase.com/rpc/v1/base/<KEY>). When set and sponsorship is enabled, batch payouts run gasless via an ERC-4337 smart account. Also settable via CDP_PAYMASTER_URL env var.
